newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Nanshan Development to set US$25 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China Nanshan Development to set US$25 mln loan.

text.p: China Nanshan Development (Group) Inc has mandated NatWest Markets to arrange a US$25 million transferable term loan facility, NatWest said Tuesday.

The facility is unconditionally guaranteed by Shenzhen Chiwan Wharf Holdings and Shenzhen Chiwan Petroleum Supply Base Co, both of which are listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and are subsidiaries of Nanshan.
The facility has a maturity of five years with a lenders' put option at the end of year three. It pay a margin of 120 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.

Lead managers committing to US$5 million receive fees of 70 basis points for an all-in return of about 143 basis points and managers committing to US$3-4 million receive fees of 60 basis points for an all-in return of 140 basis points.
Nanshan is a Sino-foreign joint venture formed to develop the Chiwan harbour into a major port and transportation centre and to promote ancillary industries.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to partially finance the construction of berths and grain silos located at terminal six of the Chiwan harbour, NatWest said.
